reviews.title: Great Content, Terrible Subscription Model — 1 Star
reviews.text:
I’ve subscribed to annual plans on several short-drama apps and have personally reviewed over 20 platforms in this genre. Unfortunately, after just one week with MoboReels, it’s gone straight to the bottom of my rankings.

Credit where it’s due: the content is good, some storylines are refreshingly original, and the video and audio quality are impressive. MoboReels could have easily made my top five.

However, the subscription model completely ruins the experience. The regular weekly VIP subscription is already expensive, but AFTER subscribing, I discovered yet another tier: SVIP, which costs 50% more per week just to access episodes early!

To put that into perspective, just TWO WEEKS of SVIP cost almost as much as an ENTIRE YEAR of the advertised annual VIP plan. A full year of SVIP would cost approximately 26 TIMES more!

Good content doesn’t justify such excessive pricing. I won’t renew even the regular weekly VIP subscription.

Once my subscription expires, I’m deleting the app and hiding any MoboReels advertisements I encounter. What could have been one of my top five short-drama apps has become my least recommended. Extremely disappointing. I wouldn’t even recommend downloading this app in the first place.

I heard about this app through a friend and enjoyed the previews I watched, so I purchased an annual VIP subscription and received an emailed confirmation and receipt. A day later, it does not recognize my log in info. When I try to reset the password, it says my email address does not exist. Now, by reading other reviews, I see that this is a common problem. I sent an inquiry about my missing subscription to support via the app, but I’m not hopeful considering the other reviews I’ve just read. Also, the developer’s standard response to complaints that updates are coming soon seems disingenuous, but I hope I’m wrong about that. I do know that you should never have trouble accessing an app that you’ve paid for.

reviews.title: I would not recommend this app
reviews.text:
⭐️☆☆☆☆

I would not recommend this app.

The stories themselves may be interesting, but the way the app handles “watch an ad to unlock” is incredibly frustrating. I watched FOUR ads in a row trying to unlock the next episode, and it still kept sending me back to the same episode.

These are not even normal ads with a clear countdown and an obvious close button. A lot of them are playable game ads, and it is not clear when the ad has actually finished. You are pushed toward downloading the game, and if you did that every time, you would end up with loads of games on your phone that you never wanted in the first place.

I do not think it is fair to advertise “watch an ad to unlock” when the ad does not clearly end or reliably unlock the next episode afterwards.

I would happily watch a normal advert every few episodes, but forcing people through repeated interactive game ads like this just feels designed to wear you down until you pay.

After four ads in a row and still not progressing, I gave up.

Waste of time. Deleted the app.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
This is honestly one of the worst payment systems I have ever seen. A complete waste of money.

I spent about $20 on coins, expecting to watch at least a few short series. Instead, I COULDN’T EVEN FINISH ONE SINGLE SERIES.

The series has around 50 very short episodes, most of them under 5 minutes. After spending $20, I only made it to around episode 35 before the coins were gone.

Think about that: $20 is not even enough to finish ONE short-form series. That is absolutely ridiculous.

When I contacted customer support, instead of giving a straightforward explanation, they started giving me confusing excuses about how coins don’t provide “access” but are used to “unlock” episodes, and how VIP works differently.

I honestly don’t care what terminology you use. I paid $20 and still couldn’t finish one series.

The whole pricing system feels unnecessarily confusing, and you only realize how little you are actually getting after you have already spent the money.

For around $20, many legitimate streaming services give you an entire month with thousands of movies and full-length TV shows. Here, $20 couldn’t even get me through one short series made up of a few-minute episodes.

Terrible value for money. Extremely disappointing. I will not spend another cent on this app, and I absolutely do not recommend it.

If you are thinking about buying coins, think twice. You may spend $20 and still not even be able to finish one series.

1 star. I would give it 0 stars if that were possible.

reviews.title: Disappointing subscription system and no end on many stories.
reviews.text:
The app does have some good and entertaining stories, but unfortunately the way the subscription works completely ruins the experience for me.

I paid for VIP expecting that this would allow me to watch the full stories. However, even after paying for VIP, some films still require an additional SVIP subscription/payment to continue and actually finish watching them. Otherwise, you have to wait several days just to unlock a few very short episodes — sometimes only a few minutes of viewing at a time. I find this extremely frustrating and unfair, especially when you are already paying for a subscription.

If someone pays weekly or monthly or yearly for VIP, it should be made very clear before subscribing that this does not necessarily give access to complete stories and that another level of payment may still be required.

Another issue is that some stories don’t seem to have a proper ending. You spend a considerable amount of time watching a film, only for it to suddenly finish without a satisfying or complete conclusion.

There are much better short-drama apps available where one subscription gives you access to complete stories without constantly asking for additional payments or making you wait days to watch another three or four minutes.

The stories themselves can be enjoyable, but the confusing VIP/SVIP system, extra charges and incomplete endings make this app very difficult to recommend. I cancelled my subscription and would not recommend subscribing.

reviews.title: Greedy developers
reviews.text:
The main reason I only gave two stars is because I purchased a subscription believing I’d have access to all episodes of all shows and what I got was unlimited access to all except the last 10 episodes. 
My subscription was a reverse of the normal. After paying, I was able to watch 60 out of 70, then was “told” I either had to purchase early access or wait 12 hours before I could watch more. When the 12 hours was up, I was able to watch 3 episodes before getting the message that I would need to purchase early access or wait 17 hours this time before continuing to watch. At this rate, it’s going to take 4 days to finish. Doing this is nothing more than a money grab. 
When someone pays for a subscription, it should be full access, not some access and either wait for days or pay more to finish in a timely manner.
